ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: PeerSky uses the camera to scan QR codes when you link a device or open a shared room or drive, to take photos you send in PeerChat or set as a group picture, and when a website you visit requests it and you allow access.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: PeerSky uses your local network to discover and connect to nearby PeerSky devices.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PeerSky uses your location only when a website you visit requests it and you allow access.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: PeerSky uses the microphone only when a website you visit requests it and you allow access.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: PeerSky saves a picture or video to your photo library when you choose Save to Photos.

android.peerchat_background_text: Staying connected so messages reach you
android.peerchat_background_channel_description: Keeps PeerChat connected while PeerSky is in the background
